caseName: Andersen v. Planned Parenthood Kan. & Mid-Mo.
caseNameFull: Jeff ANDERSEN, Secretary, Kansas Department of Health and Environment v. PLANNED PARENTHOOD OF KANSAS AND MID-MISSOURI

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied. Justice THOMAS, with whom Justice ALITO and Justice GORSUCH join, dissenting from denial of certiorari: I dissent for the reasons set out in Gee v. Planned Parenthood, 586 U.S. ----, 139 S.Ct. 408, --- L.E.2d ---- (2018) (Thomas, J., dissenting).
